nonBlockingObservations.title: Complete the advertised single-result overflow matrix
nonBlockingObservations.detail: The single-result 65537-entry loop still covers automatic and explicit-empty inputs, while the README and accepted plan describe explicit-nonempty coverage too. Cross-result explicit-nonempty and single-result explicit-empty controls already exercise the relevant mechanism; this is a nonblocking evidence-matrix gap carried from the earlier review.
nonBlockingObservations.requestedChange: Add the explicit-nonempty single-result overflow case when expanding the boundary matrix for B2-d2, or narrow the evidence description to the combinations actually exercised.
